prediction_fields.name: enforcement_budget_usd
prediction_fields.description: Total federal and state budget allocated for No Surprises Act enforcement, including complaint processing and audits.

prediction_fields.name: certified_idr_entity_count
prediction_fields.description: Number of certified independent dispute resolution entities available to adjudicate payment disputes.

prediction_fields.name: qpa_calculation_system_readiness
prediction_fields.description: Percentage of health plans with operational systems to accurately calculate the qualifying payment amount.

discussion_points: How will the enforcement budget be distributed between federal and state oversight?
What is the expected capacity and geographic coverage of certified IDR entities?
Are all health plans equipped to access the necessary contracted rate data for QPA calculation?
What are the upfront costs for providers and facilities to implement compliant billing systems?

prediction_fields.name: qpa_calculations_performed
prediction_fields.description: Number of qualifying payment amount calculations executed by health plans for out-of-network claims.

prediction_fields.name: disclosure_notices_sent
prediction_fields.description: Total number of mandatory patient protection disclosure notices distributed by plans and providers.

prediction_fields.name: initial_payments_made
prediction_fields.description: Count of initial payments sent to providers within the 30-day statutory window.

prediction_fields.name: idr_cases_initiated
prediction_fields.description: Number of payment disputes filed and initiated in the federal IDR process.

discussion_points: What barriers do plans face in calculating the QPA for uncommon or highly specialized services?
How do providers and plans coordinate to ensure timely initial payment?
What proportion of IDR initiations are for air ambulance services versus emergency and non-emergency services?
How are uninsured or self-pay patients being handled under the notice-and-consent waiver provisions?

prediction_fields.name: protected_claims_processed
prediction_fields.description: Number of out-of-network claims processed with in-network cost-sharing applied directly to the patient.

prediction_fields.name: balance_billing_attempts_blocked
prediction_fields.description: Total instances where a provider’s attempt to balance bill a patient was prevented by the plan or regulator.

prediction_fields.name: idr_determinations_completed
prediction_fields.description: Number of IDR disputes that received a final payment determination within the review period.

prediction_fields.name: compliant_notice_provision_rate
prediction_fields.description: Percentage of patient encounters where the required disclosure notice was provided correctly.

discussion_points: How often are protected claims erroneously processed with out-of-network cost-sharing?
What is the typical timeline from IDR initiation to final determination, and how does it affect cash flow for providers?
Are balance billing attempts concentrated in certain specialties or geographic regions?
To what extent are patients aware of their right to receive the notice and file complaints?

prediction_fields.name: reduction_in_prevalence_of_out_of_network_bills_for_non_emergency_services_at_in_network_facilities_in_2022
prediction_fields.description: reduction in prevalence of out-of-network bills for non-emergency services at in-network facilities in 2022 (%)

prediction_fields.name: reduction_in_prevalence_of_out_of_network_bills_for_emergency_services_in_2022
prediction_fields.description: reduction in prevalence of out-of-network bills for emergency services in 2022 (%)

prediction_fields.name: reduction_emergency_oon_bills_pct
prediction_fields.description: Percentage point reduction in the prevalence of out-of-network bills for emergency services (relative to pre-NSA baseline).

prediction_fields.name: reduction_nonemergency_oon_bills_pct
prediction_fields.description: Percentage point reduction in the prevalence of out-of-network bills for non-emergency services at in-network facilities.

prediction_fields.name: patient_outofpocket_savings_per_claim_usd
prediction_fields.description: Average reduction in patient out-of-pocket payment per protected out-of-network claim.

prediction_fields.name: consumer_protection_awareness_pct
prediction_fields.description: Percentage of covered individuals who are aware of their surprise billing protections under the No Surprises Act.

discussion_points: Has the drop in emergency out-of-network billing been uniform across all types of emergency departments?
Are there substitution effects, such as more out-of-network elective care, offsetting the reductions?
Do the savings per claim differ significantly between emergency and non-emergency services?
How do patient complaint rates correlate with localized enforcement effort and awareness campaigns?

prediction_fields.name: systemic_oon_billing_prevalence
prediction_fields.description: Long-term prevalence of out-of-network balance billing for all services, reflecting market equilibrium.

prediction_fields.name: network_adequacy_index
prediction_fields.description: Composite index measuring the in-network availability of essential healthcare services across plans.

prediction_fields.name: average_health_plan_premium_impact_pct
prediction_fields.description: Estimated percentage change in health plan premiums attributable to NSA compliance and payment reforms.

discussion_points: Will the No Surprises Act accelerate consolidation among providers or health plans as networks adjust?
Does the policy lead to a durable culture of price transparency and fair billing beyond the letter of the law?
How does the IDR process influence long-term contracting behavior between plans and providers?
Are any unintended consequences emerging, such as reduced access to out-of-network specialists in rural areas?
